acts.words: Don't look at me like that, Leo, you're the one who was complaining about the rations yesterday.
Where is the other can? Who took it?
I didn't take it, I swear. Someone else must have been up in the night.
Stop this right now. Which one of you took the can?
I didn't touch it, Daniel. Stop looking for someone to blame just because you're stressed.
Someone must have taken it. Just tell us who did it.
I already told you, it wasn't me! Someone else must have taken it while we were all asleep.
I am looking again.
You emptied my bag yesterday, Daniel, so you're the one looking through everyone's things.
You're tearing the room apart like you already know it's not here, Leo!
I'm not done checking every corner in here.

acts.words: I'm going to look myself so nobody can say I missed anything.
I didn't take the food, and I won't stand here while you all look at me like a thief.
Let's divide what is left right now so everyone sees it's fair and we can stop accusing each other.

acts.words: I'm not stopping until I've checked everywhere.

acts.words: If we all just ate our share, then where did the missing can go?

It's alright, Daniel. We were all hungry, but we have to share what little is left.
It's okay, Daniel. We were all starving, I'm just glad you finally told the truth.
I'm sorry for snapping and lying, but I promise I'll figure out a way to keep us all safe.
We have no food left now, so we must stay calm and figure out what to do next together.
I'm going to check the front window to see if there's any way out for supplies.
We are going to be fine, just stay close to me and we'll get through this.
Don't worry, I'm watching the street now and I won't let anything happen to any of you.
Let's all take a breath and stay together, we will figure this out.
We are going to make it through this, I promise I will find a way.
We are still together, and that is what matters most right now.
I need to go talk to Leo about this.
We are going to take care of each other, no matter what comes next.
